name: daily-dev
description: Everyday helpers (neutral tier — consistency, not advantage): test-gen, error-explain, deploy-check.

intent.goal: Write unit tests for this function.
constraints: cover edge cases and negative cases
include a fixture if state needed

style_hints.claude: XML-wrapped code block with a brief test strategy note
style_hints.gpt: markdown code block with test case comments
style_hints.kimi: just the code, no extra prose

intent.goal: Explain this Python error and give the exact fix.
constraints: name the root cause in one sentence

style_hints.claude: structured XML: cause, fix, corrected snippet
style_hints.gpt: numbered steps: 1. cause 2. fix 3. corrected code
style_hints.kimi: fix first, cause second - no preamble

intent.goal: Check this code for production readiness before deployment.
constraints: check error handling, secrets, logging, input validation

outputs.format: checklist with status and one-line finding per item

style_hints.claude: XML checklist with structured finding elements
style_hints.gpt: markdown checklist table: category | status | finding
